long_biography.plain_text:
Creating Oddo Vins & Domaines with his daughter Lorraine gave Pascal Oddo a new operating project after decades in financial markets. The family group assembled estates in France, South Africa, Italy and Spain, combining ownership with active work on terroir, production and distribution.

That wine business sits within the family holding Vasgos, where Oddo chairs the supervisory board. A dedicated subsidiary combines managed forests with wind and solar projects under a long-term investment model. Lorraine now chairs the holding, while Axel Oddo serves as managing director and Pascal remains supervisory-board chairman.
